subject: Clarify virtual-account mapping and VAT flags for incoming remittance - NimblePay
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@nimblepay.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Accounts Payable <ap@nimblepay.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 17:05:00 +0000
Subject: Remittance advice & VAT treatment (NIM-INV batch)

Hi Marcus,

Attached is our remittance advice for payments processed on 2026-11-30. We're sending payment by SEPA credit to the clearing account referenced below. Can you confirm the allocation to the invoice numbers in column "InvoiceRef" and whether Redwood will apply the EU reverse-charge VAT flag for the affected lines?

Summary (from remit):
- Payment date: 2026-11-30
- Amount: EUR 452,310.55
- Bank reference: NIM/SEPA/73019
- Currency: EUR

Notes: a handful of remittance rows do not include the Virtual Account ID (VA-###) in the csv. Our AR system normally writes the VA value, but the export we generated for this sweep may have dropped it for 3 lines. We included invoice refs and invoice amounts.

Attachment: [Attachment: remit_advice_20261130.csv (CSV, 18KB)]

Can you confirm allocation and let us know if you need a bank trace? Happy to send a revised csv if that helps.

Thanks,
Elena Soto
Finance Operations
NimblePay, Inc.
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@nimblepay.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 08:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Remittance advice & VAT treatment (NIM-INV batch)

Thanks for the remit, Elena — I have visibility into the sweep but need a quick confirm from our collections team on the VA mapping and VAT flagging.

Quick status: our clearing bank received the funds and they swept to the central collection ledger overnight (bank adv attached). Because three remit rows are missing a VA identifier, our matching engine held them as "unapplied" pending manual mapping. For EU reverse-charge: if the invoice metadata includes a reverse-charge indicator (you typically pass that via the invoice metadata field or via the VA mapping), we will set the VAT handling accordingly.

Actions I'm taking:
- Looping in Laura to validate the three unmatched lines and map them by invoice reference.
- Looping in Vanessa to confirm whether we should treat the lines as reverse-charge or VAT-exempt given the invoice descriptors.

If needed, Elena, a revised CSV with VA IDs will speed things up — happy to accept that and perform a re-statement against the ledger. If you prefer, we can do an accounting re-allocation (journal) to clear the unapplied amounts.

Attachment: [Attachment: bank_sweep_notice_20261130.pdf (PDF, 42KB)]

Marcus Lin
Senior Billing Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Elena Soto <elena.soto@nimblepay.com>
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Remittance advice & VAT treatment (NIM-INV batch)

Thanks Marcus / Elena — I pulled the ledger extract and matched by InvoiceRef. Two of the three missing-VA lines match cleanly to open invoices (NIM-48321, NIM-48322) once you ignore a stray trailing space in the CSV. One line remains unapplied (EUR 14,320.00) because the InvoiceRef is malformed (contains a leading zero and our parser treats that as a different ID).

Proposed resolution:
- We'll accept a corrected CSV from NimblePay where the VA ID is added (preferred) OR
- We can manually post a remittance application for the malformed InvoiceRef if you confirm it's NIM-48323 (please reply).

VAT handling: the invoice records in our system have a custom attribute "vat_mode". For NIM-48321/48322 the attribute is "reverse_charge: true". For the unmatched line, the invoice does not have a vat_mode set. Vanessa, please confirm whether we should set the unmatched invoice to reverse-charge or leave it standard VAT-exempt pending NimblePay confirmation.

Attachment: [Attachment: internal_ledger_extract_20261130.xlsx (XLSX, 24KB)]

Laura Bennett
Collections Lead | Redwood Inference
From: Accounts Payable <ap@nimblepay.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 11:28:00 +0000

Hi all,

Apologies — I missed the VA column on one export. I've attached a revised remittance csv where VA IDs are populated and the InvoiceRef typo for NIM-48323 is fixed. The bank trace is NIM/SEPA/73019 and the SWIFT image is included. Please apply the revised CSV against the sweep; we confirm the EUR 14,320.00 should post to NIM-48323 and that NIM-48321/48322 are reverse-charge transactions.

Attachments: [Attachment: remit_advice_20261130-revised.csv (CSV, 19KB)] [Attachment: swift_image_73019.pdf (PDF, 33KB)]
